description: Data files: Electric vehicle charging dataset with 35,000 charging sessions from 12 residential locations in Norway is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Åse Lekang Sørensen (SINTEF). Please refer to the data article where the data is described (Data-in-brief, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dib.2024.110883). The data article refers to the paper "A method for generating complete EV charging datasets and analysis of residential charging behaviour in a large Norwegian case study". Coverage: national (NO); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
